title: Beyond Code
intro: The communities I lead and the recognition that came with the work.

testimonials.name: Tarek Atwan
testimonials.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Devanshu Tayal and can confidently recommend him for any role related to time series analysis and sales forecasting. He is a hardworking and dedicated individual who consistently delivers high-quality results. His expertise in building forecasting models is impressive and his ability to communicate effectively makes him a valuable asset to any team. Devanshu is also a great team player who is always looking to learn and grow, making him a pleasure to work with. I highly recommend Devanshu for any opportunity in the field of data analytics and forecasting.
testimonials.highlight: His expertise in building forecasting models is impressive

testimonials.name: Amol Gunjal
testimonials.quote: I’ve had the privilege of working with Devanshu and what truly stands out is their ability to architect data-driven intelligence across analytics, AI, and engineering ecosystems. They bring a rare blend of deep technical expertise and strategic vision.
testimonials.highlight: a rare blend of deep technical expertise and strategic vision

testimonials.name: Priyanka Khatri
testimonials.quote: While our teams worked on the same client to build out the company’s revenue. I found him to be hard-working, bright, and a skilled communicator. I particularly enjoyed his sense of humor in the face of what can sometimes be a stressful situation when faced with tight deadlines. But what makes him stand out is his willingness to help others. He sets realistic goals and gives clear instructions and feedback. He instills pride, confidence, and positive energy in everyone. I would welcome the opportunity to work with him again. I am glad to have worked with him and have no hesitation recommending him to potential employers. If you have the chance to work with Devanshu, take it! 😉
testimonials.highlight: If you have the chance to work with Devanshu, take it!

testimonials.name: Omowumi Ogidi
testimonials.quote: I recently met Er. Devanshu at the Tableau DataFam event in January where he gave me some great tips. After, I reached out for help setting up my GitHub. He generously took the time to walk me through the process. His patience, expertise, and willingness to help stood out, making what seemed like a daunting task much more approachable. I truly appreciate his guidance and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and supportive professional in the tech community!
testimonials.highlight: His patience, expertise, and willingness to help stood out

testimonials.name: Priyanshi Tiwari
testimonials.quote: I recently had an inspiring conversation with Devanshu. We delved into data analytics and machine learning models, and he made these complex concepts both interesting and insightful. Devanshu’s energy and passion for his work are truly contagious, and I was impressed by how he uses real-world examples to clarify ideas, making them easy to grasp. I look forward to many more exciting conversations. Thank you, Devanshu!
testimonials.highlight: he made these complex concepts both interesting and insightful
